_comment: The component contract. One row per Fluid component: which layer it lives in, the single root class it renders, and how a bare modifier token from the 1.x templates maps onto a data attribute. Build/Scripts/refactor-templates-to-components.php, Build/Scripts/migrate-component-css.mjs, Build/Scripts/build-astryx-css.mjs and Tests/Unit/AtomicDesignConformanceTest.php all read this file and nothing else, so the vocabulary is stated once.
_upstream: data-variant, data-size, data-type, data-color, data-status, data-level, data-weight and data-selected are Astryx v0.6.0 attribute names, taken from the compiled theme rules in Build/astryx/tokens.json. The remaining names are this extension's, for modifiers upstream has no equivalent for.

layout.section.name: Section
layout.section.note: The root of every content element. Owns vertical rhythm and surface.

layout.container.name: Container
layout.container.note: Measure and gutters. `astryx-layout` is the historical root class.

atom.text.name: Text
atom.text.note: Upstream keys Text off data-type, with data-size and data-color beside it.

atom.featureIcon.name: FeatureIcon
atom.featureIcon.note: The tinted square a feature glyph sits in. Six different parents place one, so it belongs to none of them; Feature calls it like anybody else.

atom.avatarGroup.name: AvatarGroup
atom.avatarGroup.note: A cluster of overlapping portraits. The overlap is derived from the one size set on the group, so an avatar inside it never sizes itself.

molecule.bannerContent.name: BannerContent
molecule.bannerContent.note: The middle column of a banner. It is what shrinks when the message is long, so it has to hold the whole message.

molecule.bannerTitle.name: BannerTitle
molecule.bannerTitle.note: A banner heading: body size, heavier weight, a real h2-h6. Not Atom/Heading, which would bring the page type scale into a tinted box.

molecule.bannerBody.name: BannerBody
molecule.bannerBody.note: The message under a banner title. A div rather than a paragraph where it carries editor rich text.

molecule.tab.name: Tab
molecule.tab.note: One trigger in a tab list. Carries data-g-tab, which is what astryx.js binds the arrow keys to.

molecule.breadcrumbItem.name: BreadcrumbItem
molecule.breadcrumbItem.note: One crumb. The separator is drawn from crumb-to-crumb adjacency, so the class has to be on the crumb itself.

molecule.paginationDots.name: PaginationDots
molecule.paginationDots.note: The row of dots under a slideshow. Deliberately not a region of Pagination: it moves the reader within one band rather than between documents.

molecule.paginationDot.name: PaginationDot
molecule.paginationDot.note: One dot, as a link to a fragment, so which view is showing survives a reload and the back button.

molecule.carouselItem.name: CarouselItem
molecule.carouselItem.note: One cell of a carousel track. The snap alignment is the cell’s own, so the class cannot be inferred by the track around it.

molecule.popover.name: Popover
molecule.popover.note: The surface a menu or filter list opens onto. Where it opens is the caller’s: a native [popover] and a <details> disclosure both use it.

molecule.segmentedControlItem.name: SegmentedControlItem
molecule.segmentedControlItem.note: One segment of a segmented control. Renders as a TypoLink or a plain anchor, the same rule Button follows.

molecule.outlineItem.name: OutlineItem
molecule.outlineItem.note: One line of an on-this-page rail. The current marker is painted from aria-current, never from a class.

organism.errorMessage.name: ErrorMessage
organism.errorMessage.note: The heading, status number and way home on a 404 or 403 page. An organism because it is the page’s own h1, not an element an editor places.

organism.pageSidebar.name: PageSidebar
organism.pageSidebar.note: A content page’s body when sibling links sit beside it: the two-column grid and the nav landmark inside it. Sits inside a Container, like PageHeader.
